question: What can a participant do after accepting the todo assignment?

youtubeLink.caption: Plantour Participant After Accepted Todo
youtubeLink.description: This video explains what a participant can do after accepting the todo assignment

sections.beforeHtml: After acceptance, the shared todo becomes part of the participant`s personal trip work. Plantour creates a corresponding row in that participant`s Trip Todos list.
items: Find the accepted todo in your personal trip todos. Plantour shows assignment status text there so you can see that it came from a shared-todo assignment.
When you complete the assignment successfully, mark Finished success on that trip todo row.
If you attempted it but it failed, mark Finished failure on that trip todo row.
Plantour sends the admin a notification when you finish the accepted todo successfully or with failure.
sections.afterHtml: The shared-todo page is where assignment is accepted or rejected. The personal Trip Todos page is where the accepted work is actually finished.
